sources.title: SZLHOLDINGS/szl-blocked · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: When a governed call is denied, the op never runs, and the chain records an honest BLOCKED receipt rather than a success. Its companion szl_euaiact derives an EU AI Act Annex IV-style draft technical-documentation skeleton from that provenance — an organizational aid, not compliance evidence, legal advice, or a declaration of conformity.
